text:
Franco Moretti is a rare blend of technical rigor and collaborative insight, having thrived as a Tech Lead at NexaPay Solutions—a fintech startup navigating complex regulatory and technical challenges. His work centered on building scalable payment platforms, where he balanced innovation with operational precision.  

Technical abilities highlight his comfort with Python for backend logic and REST API design, which he applied to streamline integration between NexaPay’s payment gateways and third-party services. His system design approach prioritized simplicity and maintainability, as seen in a recent project where he restructured a monolithic module into microservices, reducing deployment friction by 40% without compromising security.  

Soft skills shine in his Agile/Scrum practice, where he adapted sprint planning to accommodate shifting regulatory requirements while keeping the team aligned. His cross-team collaboration extended beyond coding; he mediated between dev and compliance teams to resolve conflicting priorities, ensuring deadlines met without sacrificing standards. Stakeholder communication was equally deliberate—he crafted technical documentation that demystified complex workflows for non-technical executives, fostering trust and clarity.  

Franco’s impact on the team was both practical and cultural. He mentored junior engineers through code reviews, emphasizing readability over shortcuts, and championed technical writing as a tool for knowledge sharing. His work ethic is defined by persistence: once, he spent three nights debugging a rare edge case in transaction validation, ultimately preventing a potential $500K liability.  

Franco’s ability to merge technical excellence with empathetic leadership makes him a valuable asset. I endorse his candidacy without reservation.
